title: Task
description: A pm-dispatch task — runtime projection of a BACKLOG.md row. Markdown stays primary; this schema documents the row shape and the lifecycle the row's status column encodes.

id.description: Ticket id. Pattern matches pm/schema.md grammar (e.g. CC-229, JS-106, CC-025b).

state.description: Editing source-of-truth: core/policy/task-states.yaml. Keep in sync.

epic.description: Maps to BACKLOG row epic column. Kept as a free string; the policy layer may narrow the valid values.

area.description: Maps to BACKLOG row area column. Kept as a free string; the policy layer may narrow the valid values.

dispatched_to.description: Agent name recorded when task transitions to in-progress via task dispatch.

brief_file.description: Optional brief file path recorded at dispatch time.

review_result.description: Review outcome recorded when task transitions to done via task review.

review_note.description: Optional reviewer note recorded at review time.

behavioral_units.description: Estimated behavioral unit count. Drives size_tier derivation when size_tier is absent.

size_tier.description: Task size tier. trivial: 0-1 units; small: ~2 units; substantial: ≥3 units or cross-module/new-interface.
